details.description: Inspect and edit information for this text box.

fonts.noFavorites: Star fonts to add them here
fonts.noFavoritesHere: None of your favorites are available here. Turn off Favorites only to see all fonts.

lettering.autoDescription: New translations, and boxes whose category changes, get their category's font.
lettering.autoOff: Fonts follow categories only while {{setting}} is on ({{tab}}).
lettering.description: Choose fonts by how a line is presented or delivered. Each box takes the category picked for it, or else one read from the page: a sound effect, small original lettering, or the shape of its bubble.
lettering.locked: This text, or a layer it's in, is locked. Unlock it in Layers to change its category.
lettering.ownNone: None yet: a category without its own font is lettered as Normal Dialogue is, and Normal Dialogue without one in the default font.

shapeNotes.none: Also used for text without a bubble.

lettering.suggestDescription: Fill categories without a font from your starting font list, using only available fonts. Existing choices stay as you set them.
lettering.suggestedNone: Nothing to suggest: the categories on the starting list already have a font, or none of its fonts is available.
lettering.title: Lettering categories

notice.locked: The layer that box would go in is locked. Unlock it first.
notice.nothing_to_read: Nothing to read in that box.

ocrBox.defaultModeDescription: Hold Alt as you let go to read only, or Shift to read, translate and clean.
ocrBox.description: A box drawn with the O tool becomes a text block. It's always read, and its action decides whether it's also translated and cleaned.

pipeline.detectColorsDescription: Copies the fill and outline colors of the original lettering onto newly translated text. Existing translations keep their colors.
pipeline.detectColorsNote: When it's off, newly translated text uses the default text colors ({{tab}}).

behavior.description: Applies to every run, whoever starts it.

runs.description: Retry failures, choose the run order, and save stage presets.
runs.finishSoundDescription: Chimes when a run over pages ends, with a lower tone when it had problems.

onFailureModes.continue: Keep going with the other pages

orders.stagesHint: Loads one model at a time, which uses less graphics memory.

presets.description: A preset switches on its stages in the Run menu and starts nothing.

presets.title: Run presets

runs.retriesDescription: Wait 2, 5, then 10 seconds between retries (0–5 retries).
runs.title: Runs

typesetting.description: Colors for new text. Text you add with the {{tool}} tool always gets them; new translations get them when “{{setting}}” is off ({{tab}}).
typesetting.font: The default font is the first in {{list}}: new text gets a copy of it, so changing it later leaves finished pages alone.
typesetting.title: Default text style

translator.instructionsDescription: Optional, in any language and form, such as a name's spelling or the tone. Booharu adds them, as written, after its own system prompt.

typesetting.empty: No default families. Booharu will use the system fallback.
typesetting.fontFallbackDescription: Booharu uses the first available family that supports the text.
